description: 경상남도 의령군_전기차충전소 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상남도 의령군. 본 데이터는 경상남도 의령군 전기차충전소 정보를 제공하며 충전소명을 기준으로 위도, 경도, 완속충전가능여부, 급속충전가능여부 등을 조회할 수 있습니다. 자료는 전기차 충전 인프라 현황 파악, 친환경 교통 확대, 충전소 관리 정책에 활용됩니다. 행정기관은 이를 통해 운영 실태를 점검하고 향후 인프라 확충... Coverage: 경상남도 의령군. The portal files it under the publisher 경상남도 의령군. Its tags are 친환경자동차, 충전소, 충전인프라, 전기차, 교통. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
